verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Netlify generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data, such as analytics or deploy data, inside the product. Its project analytics (netlify-docs-17) have no AI component, and its dashboard AI agents (netlify-docs-21) fix and ship code rather than analyze data. AI Gateway (netlify-docs-24) is a developer building block for apps users build, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
